title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Acts 19: Paul at Ephesus, the sons of Sceva, the burning of the books, and the uproar in the theater.

questions.text: What did the disciples at Ephesus answer when Paul asked whether they had received the Holy Spirit?
questions.explanation: They said they had not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.

answers.text: That they had received him when they believed
That they had not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit
That Apollos had already given him to them
That they were waiting for him in Jerusalem

questions.text: Into what had those disciples been baptized before Paul spoke with them?
questions.explanation: They said they had been baptized into John's baptism, and afterward they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

answers.text: Into the name of the Lord Jesus
Into the baptism of the Holy Spirit
Into John's baptism
Into the baptism of Apollos

questions.text: How many were the men on whom Paul laid his hands at Ephesus?
questions.explanation: When Paul laid his hands on them the Holy Spirit came on them, and they were about twelve men in all.

answers.text: About twelve
About seven
About forty
About seventy

questions.text: Where did Paul reason daily after he had departed from the synagogue?
questions.explanation: He separated the disciples and reasoned daily in the school of Tyrannus.

answers.text: In the theater of the city
In the house of Aquila
In the temple of Artemis
In the school of Tyrannus

questions.text: What happened when handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from Paul's body to the sick?
questions.explanation: The diseases departed from them and the evil spirits went out.

answers.text: The diseases departed and the evil spirits went out
The dead among them were raised
The crowds of the city were stilled
Those who touched them began to prophesy

questions.text: What did the evil spirit answer the exorcists who invoked the name of the Lord Jesus?
questions.explanation: The evil spirit said, "Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?"

answers.text: I know neither Jesus nor Paul
Great is Artemis, whom all Asia worships
Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?
Why do you come to torment us?

questions.text: What did those who had practiced magical arts do with their books?
questions.explanation: They brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all, and the price of them was counted at fifty thousand pieces of silver.

answers.text: They sold them for fifty thousand pieces of silver
They hid them away in the temple of Artemis
They handed them over to Demetrius the silversmith
They brought them together and burned them in the sight of all

questions.text: Who was Demetrius, and what did he make?
questions.explanation: Demetrius was a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis and brought much business to the craftsmen.

answers.text: The town clerk of the city of Ephesus
A silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis
A maker of tents who worked with Paul
A chief priest whose sons were exorcists

questions.text: Where did the whole city rush, and whom had they seized?
questions.explanation: They rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia and Paul's companions in travel.

answers.text: Into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus
Into the synagogue, having seized Alexander
Into the temple of Artemis, having seized Paul
Into the school of Tyrannus, having seized the disciples

questions.text: What did the town clerk say when he had quieted the multitude?
questions.explanation: He said that everyone knows Ephesus is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and that since these things cannot be denied they ought to be quiet and do nothing rash.

answers.text: That Paul should be handed over to the craftsmen
That the temple of Artemis should be shut up for a time
That Ephesus is temple keeper of Artemis and they should do nothing rash
That Demetrius should be put out of the city at once
